title: Adam Savage's Spot Robot Rickshaw Carriage!
summary: Adam Savage builds a Victorian-style rickshaw carriage for Boston Dynamics' Spot robot to pull, with him riding as passenger. The video covers the build and the engineering problems of pairing cutting-edge robotics with vintage transport, such as tuning the payload through Spot's API.
why: HN commenters cite it as a fun real-world example of Spot hauling a passenger whenever Boston Dynamics robots come up.
